thread:
incident-bot: Pager: P1 - Cloud KMS API errors impacting service startup and request signing across hosted and dedicated (multiple regions). Automated alerts: high rate of KMS timeouts and 5xx errors.

oncall-alex: Seeing the pager. Confirming impact: autoscaled workers failing at init, some request signing ops timing out. Putting a notification to #eng-oncall.

eng-sre-jordan: Ongoing errors from KMS clients. Sample stack trace from one failing pod:
```
2024-05-28T14:12:07Z ERROR runtime: failed to decrypt env var: context deadline exceeded
caused by: kms: Request timed out (client timeout 2s)

aws-sdk-go: RequestError: send request failed
caused by: Post \"https://kms.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/\": net/http: TLS handshake timeout
```

eng-runtime-maya: We're seeing both AWS KMS and GCP KMS metrics spike in latency in US regions, correlates with our startup errors. Auth signing retries also increasing 5xx on downstream services.

prod-support-sam: Customer reports: several API clients getting 500s during early morning surge. Triage: mark high customer impact (payment flows and webhooks).

oncall-alex: First mitigation actions: 1) Increase KMS client timeouts and retry window in runtime config to avoid immediate startup failures. 2) Enable local ENV fallback for decrypt (cached fallback key) for critical services. 3) Throttle non-essential background jobs to reduce KMS load. Executing now.

eng-sre-jordan: Pushing a hotfix to runtime config: 
```yml
KMS_CLIENT_TIMEOUT_MS: 8000
KMS_MAX_RETRIES: 5
KMS_BACKOFF_MS: 300
ENABLE_LOCAL_KEY_CACHE: true
```
Rolling to dedicated and hosted pools (canary -> 10% -> 50% -> all).

security-ops-lina: Note: enabling local key cache is okay short-term for availability, but we need to ensure keys are sealed at rest. Confirming HSM/KMS audit log capture for any decrypts during this window.

eng-runtime-maya: Canary shows immediate improvement for new instances — startup success rate from ~60% to ~98% in canary. However existing instances still have intermittent signing errors because they hit 5xx when calling KMS for ephemeral token signing.

prod-support-sam: Updating affected customers with interim message: "We're mitigating an issue impacting some request flows; API retries and delayed processing may occur. We're working on a fix". Sent to top 20 customers.

eng-sre-jordan: Additional mitigation: add server-side short-circuit for signing: if KMS unavailable, use pre-signed token cache with TTL 5m for validated service tokens. Implemented with feature flag `SIGNING_FALLBACK_CACHE=true`.

oncall-alex: Handoff: I'm paged for another incident; @eng-sre-jordan you're now primary on-call for this thread. @eng-runtime-maya please continue rollout and monitor signing error rate.

eng-sre-jordan: Ack. Monitoring dashboards: KMS 5xx rate peaked at 18% for us-west-2 and 12% in us-east-1. Latency p50 -> 400ms, p95 -> 7s. Request volume to KMS unchanged. I opened ticket with AWS Support (case: 1234567890) and provided traces.

incident-bot: Incident created: INC-20240528-001 (P1). Severity: high. Pages sent: 4. On-call: eng-sre-jordan.

eng-runtime-maya: Quick logs showing signing fallback kicking in:
```
[2024-05-28T14:20:12Z] WARN signing: KMS timeout, using cached token (id=tok-9b2f) ttl=240s
[2024-05-28T14:20:14Z] INFO service: startup complete, health=ok
```

prod-support-sam: Customer-impact notes: Payments queue delayed ~15-120s per request depending on fallback hit. No data loss. Some customers on Dedicated reported transient 502s. Collecting list for RCA.

security-ops-lina: Re: compliance, ensure that cached tokens are logged and rotated once KMS fully recovered. We'll need audit log entries to show decrypts came from backup flow.

eng-sre-jordan: AWS Support responded: they have a partial degradation in KMS control plane in us-west-2 causing elevated latencies; recommended switching to us-west-1 or fallback endpoints. Also suggested temporary region failover for critical workloads.

oncall-alex: Jordan, can we route KMS calls to secondary region for new startups? What's the risk?

eng-runtime-maya: Region failover plan: create regional KMS clients that prefer local region but fall back to cross-region custom endpoint (us-west-1). Need key policy for cross-region decrypt — we've got replica keys in us-west-1 for some projects, but not all. Time to complete ~15-30 mins per service to update config and roll. Doing for critical services first (auth, payments).

eng-sre-jordan: Rolling cross-region fallback for auth & payments now. Monitoring: auth startup errors drop to <1% after switch. Payments improved but still seeing retries because of queue backlog.

customer-success-zoe: Notifying affected customers with ETA for full recovery ~2h. Sending more detailed post-incident note after stabilization.

prod-support-sam: Note: we've paused some non-critical auto-deployments to reduce churn and KMS calls. Also disabled scheduled analytics jobs touching encrypted envs.

eng-runtime-maya: Action item: add robust local key cache and signing fallback to runbook (postmortem). Also add healthcheck that fails fast if KMS latency > 2s for >5m so we can trigger safer rollouts earlier.

security-ops-lina: I'm tracking potential key exposure window: local cache used only on ephemeral instances with mTLS and disk encryption. We'll run a key audit after incident.

eng-sre-jordan: AWS KMS latency normalized in us-west-2 at 14:50 UTC, 38 minutes after start. We began gradual rollback of cross-region fallback and disabled temporary caches in non-critical services. No further 5xx spikes.

incident-bot: Incident INC-20240528-001 moved to Mitigated.

eng-sre-jordan: Post-incident next steps (assigned):
- Open RCA doc and link in incident channel.
- Update runbooks: add SIGNING_FALLBACK_CACHE steps, local cache config, and region-failover checklist.
- Add automated health alert for KMS p95 latency > 2s for 10m.
- Request formal postmortem review with Security and Product.
- Follow up with AWS Support for root cause and prevention.

prod-support-sam: I'll prepare customer impact summary and list of affected tenants.

security-ops-lina: I'll run key audit and confirm no unauthorized decrypts beyond cached fallbacks.

customer-success-zoe: Scheduling proactive outreach and an FAQ for customers about how we mitigate KMS outages and our failover guarantees.

oncall-alex: Thanks @eng-sre-jordan and @eng-runtime-maya for handling while I was on the other page. Closing my part of handoff.

eng-sre-jordan: Wrapping up: final status — services stabilized, mitigations rolled back where safe, customer notifications sent. Will post RCA link shortly.

incident-bot: Incident INC-20240528-001 marked resolved at 2024-05-28T15:10:21Z.

eng-sre-jordan: RCA draft: "KMS control plane partial degradation in us-west-2 caused elevated latency and intermittent 5xx; our runtime depends on KMS decrypt/sign at startup leading to restart loops. Mitigations: increased timeouts, enabled local key cache + signing fallback, cross-region KMS fallback for critical services, paused non-critical KMS consumers. Follow-ups include runbook updates, health alerts, and working with AWS on prevention."

security-ops-lina: Adding to compliance log and scheduling postmortem review next week.

customer-success-zoe: Posting customer summary to Zendesk and copying affected accounts.

eng-runtime-maya: I'll open a PR to add local key cache and fallback into mainline runtime with feature flags and tests. Link to PR will be in the RCA doc.

eng-sre-jordan: Thanks everyone. End of thread.
